title: Standing Order on the Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence
source_locator: One-page standing order; operative paragraph beginning “It is hereby ORDERED.”
court_scope: U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Ohio, Eastern Division
filing_scope: Pleadings, motions, briefs, and other documents before the issuing judge when a party uses generative AI to help generate content of any portion.
trigger_summary: A party, including a pro se litigant, uses generative AI to help generate content of any portion of the filing.
requirement_summary: A declaration uses the stated caption, identifies assisted content by location, states the platform used, and includes the stated review, accuracy, and Rule 11 certifications.
activation_blockers: The current evaluator detects only a standalone heading; it cannot verify location identification, platform information, required certifications, or exact case and judge applicability.
The retrieved order does not state an end date; a maintainer must confirm it remains governing for the selected case before activation.
